replaces: none: derive's failure cleanup had no test (#1449)
fails_if: derive stops removing its staging copy `<out>.tmp` when it refuses the base, so a refused derive leaves a partial database beside `--out`
note: `base.db` is copied to `out.db.tmp` before the schema gate reads it, so the gate's refusal (`schema_incompatible`, exit 10) is a failure after the staging file exists. The `out.db*` claim covers the sidecars too, though the gate's read-only open creates none. The command needs no catalog artifact, but the runner builds the shared one for every case without an input bundle.
